title: Finished a video game I started 10 years ago - Made an AI Harness to finish it - AMA
author: maxjbv4
selftext:
Exactly 10 years ago I started building Watch Your Back - Zombies.

Due to the complexity of the game I never finished, However, I had a clear idea of what I needed to do.

When Codex and Claude Code was released I tried to vibe coded it, but it was a total failure.

Finally, decided that I needed a way to control these AI models, so I made an AI Harness specifically for this game, it took me a few weeks to build the harness. But once done, the game was made in 100 hours and about 300 agents, 70% of it was the harness validating the game.

The game has 2 modes: Classic and Hunt, both are unlimited play and difficulty levels up after some time. Hunt has 16 taylor made arenas. There are 2 types of basic zombies, 2 bosses and one massive megaboss.

Give it a try and ask anything!
